x: At the National cross-country championships at Great Barr, Birmingham, we were pleased to see Martin Williamson with his wife, and they are living at Leamington, but Martin does not find time for any running but is keenly interested in all the Club is doing.

Newcomers to the team were Tom Clinton, Ken Stimpson, Martin Williamson and Eddie Short. Twenty-five clubs competed in 1949 and we accomplished our second hat-trick of wins, thus achieving more wins in the nineteen races held than any other club.
